name: Inverness
summary: Inverness is the gateway to the Scottish Highlands, a friendly riverside city on the Ness. Cruise Loch Ness to Urquhart Castle, stand on Culloden battlefield, walk the prehistoric Clava Cairns and watch dolphins at Chanonry Point.
seasonNote: Summer has long days; winter is dark and some sights close.
arrival: Inverness Airport is 20 minutes away; trains run from Edinburgh and the overnight sleeper from London.
gettingAround: Walk the centre; car or tours for the Highlands.
cashTip: Cards and contactless dominate; a small GBP reserve covers markets and tips.
foodTip: Highland seafood, haggis and a whisky dram.
